title: Unconscious
metaphor: A deep-indigo blue human head drooping sideways with both eyes fully closed and limp mouth, resting against one broad ivory crescent moon at upper right. No body, no stars, no blood.

Heroic hand-painted style D, chunky matte painted forms, broad soft bevels, restrained brushwork. Straight-on circular badge; outer circle fills 94 percent of square canvas, pictogram fills 80 percent of disc.
